items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know anything about him until then. You know, when I came over and Stanley (Dance) came and had me do this Basie thing in '72.

ctx.x: But Monestier, he never could understand nobody. I think he was like that just because he didn't want to understand.

You know, I was wondering because I'd always heard that. You know, sometimes he'd come over here. It was the same thing, we'd say something to him, why don't you book so and so, this or that and he'd act like he didn't quite understand what you said, you know.
